title: Midday Miniwave Deploy Canvas and Observation Sampler
summary: Short playbook for a compact midday miniwave deployment meant to land non-blocking feature patches with minimal user impact. Includes a 5-day calendar, operator checklist, telemetry sampling plan, rollback criteria and a release notes seed.
body:
Context:
This doc is intended for small-mid sized releases that we run in a constrained midday window (UTC 14:00-18:00) when cluster utilization historically dips ~12–18%. The goal is to apply incremental model-serving or routing changes with low blast radius while collecting high-fidelity signals from a focused telemetry sampler.

High-level constraints and goals:
- Target change size: small (<= 6 server-side commits, or single model variant swap).
- Max rollout population: 10% live traffic via progressive canary lanes.
- Latency SLO (p95): no regression > 15% from baseline within 30m of rollout.
- Cost: no scheduled autoscale increases unless approved by SRE lead.

5-day Deployment Calendar (compact):
Day -2 (Prep):
- Confirm merged PRs and green CI: runtime PR #842 (see linked PR).
- Update canary config: canary-lane-omega -> 2% initial split.
- Generate focused telemetry set: generate 2500 sample requests from production prompt corpus (see 'telemetry sampler' section).
- Ops dry-run: run smoke harness in staging for 30m with 1k synthetic requests.

Day -1 (Final validation):
- Nightly telemetry snapshot: verify baseline p95 and error rate.
- Owner: release engineer (Ava) to post summary to #deploys.
- Stakeholders notified: product, SRE, solutions-eng.

Day 0 (Deployment window: UTC 14:00–18:00):
T+00: 14:00 — Kickoff
- Confirm on-call roster and escalation points.
- Post 'midday-miniwave-start' message in #deploys with links and expectations.
- Verify canary route is healthy (preflight smoke).
T+05m — Canary 2% lift
- Push new model variant / config to canary-lane.
- Start telem-sampler job for canary cohorts.
T+20m — Evaluate signals
- Check smoke tests, p95 latency, 5xxs, token throughput.
- If any critical trigger, PAUSE and roll back to previous canary.
T+40m — Canary 10%
- If stable, step to 10% traffic.
T+60m — Observe and expand
- If all green for 30m, escalate to 50% (by schedule) or full depending on risk appetite.
T+180m — Post-deploy wrap
- Confirm rollout complete or rollback performed.
- Capture short debrief in doc and tag stakeholders.

Operator Checklist (run during window):
- [ ] Confirm Slack alert channel and incident channel are created.
- [ ] Confirm canary split configurations are correct in routing service.
- [ ] Ensure telemetry sampler named 'midday-miniwave-YYYYMMDD' is running and collecting both raw requests and KV-cache metrics.
- [ ] Run smoke test matrix (see below) against canary endpoints.
- [ ] Monitor memory/GPU metrics for model-serving nodes (saw-tooth pattern tolerance configured at +10%).
- [ ] Verify no unexpected rate limit errors in API gateway.
- [ ] If rollback: run rollback script and verify sticky sessions flushed.

Smoke Test Matrix (compact):
- Functional: health endpoint, /v1/generate basic prompt (5 examples), embeddings endpoint sample (3 queries).
- Latency: p50/p95/p99 for token generation; compare to baseline snapshot.
- Errors: 429/5xx delta vs baseline; any increase > 0.1% at p95 triggers investigation.
- Model quality quick-check: run 50 curated prompts and compare BLEU-ish heuristics / token-level deltas against predeploy baseline.

Telemetry Sampler Plan:
- Sample population: for the midday window, collect 2.5k live-sample requests split evenly between canary and baseline lanes. Keep request IDs for post-hoc diffs.
- Metrics to capture: request latency, backend GPU utilization, KV cache hit rate, output length, sampling temperature distribution, token-level degeneracy signals (repeats), hallucination heuristics (domain-specific).
- Retention for the sampler: keep raw traces for 48h; aggregates for 30d.
- Quick checks dashboard: prebuilt chart set 'Miniwave Sampler - Dec 2026' (link in linked_artifacts).

Release Notes (seed - to be expanded by product):
Title: Midday Miniwave — routing & small-model update (Dec 2026)
What changed: switched routing policy for low-latency experiments; deployed model-variant v2.3-small to canary lane; applied a small tokenizer fix in runtime PR #842.
Why: reduce tail latency for particularly bursty prompt shapes; unblock upcoming optimized batching experiments.
Impact and rollout: 2% -> 10% -> 50% staged rollout; no customer-visible config changes.
Known issues: under rare long-context prompts (>8k tokens) there is an increased memory footprint; mitigations applied but monitoring ongoing.

Rollback Criteria (explicit triggers):
- Any sustained p95 latency regression > 20% for 15m.
- Increase in error rate (5xx or 429) that causes overall request failure delta > 0.2% sustained for 10m.
- Telemetry sampler shows KV cache hit-rate drop > 12% correlated with latency.
- Regressions in model quality as measured by the curated 50-prompt set (average log-prob delta crossing threshold).

Post-deploy notes and debrief template (to be filled within 2h of closure):
- Deployment owner: 
- Rollout timeline: 
- Outcome: success / partial / rollback (with reason)
- Signals observed: latency p95, error delta, cache hit-rate
- Action items: immediate short fixes, follow-ups for next retro
- Links: PRs, tickets, dashboards

Open questions and preflight TODOs:
- Are there any outstanding model-licensing checks for variant v2.3-small? (action: legal confirm).
- Confirm that dedicated customers are excluded from the canary split (action: product to confirm list).
- Does the KV caching warmup script need to run 2 hours pre-deploy in low-traffic regions? (SRE recommendation pending).

Notes to reviewers:
This is intentionally concise — the target audience is the on-call release engineer and SRE lead. If we take this approach for more windows, we should centralize the telemetry-sampler dashboards and add automated gates (thresholds) to reduce manual checks. Feedback welcome on tightening rollback triggers and expanding the smoke test matrix for embeddings/re-ranking workloads.

Changelog:
- 2026-11-30 (Ava) initial draft and calendar
- 2026-12-02 (Liam) added telemetry sampler details and smoke matrix
- 2026-12-05 (Priya) updated rollback thresholds and release notes seed
